text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce was injured during training,
so I rushed her to the infirmary immediately.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ouch... Sigh, I messed up.
Taking care to avoid injury
is supposed to be the bare minimum of self-management...
choice_data_list: All we can do now is make sure you get proper rest.
All we can do now is make sure you get proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...About that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I dare to make a proposal!
Let's resume our training!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
An injury is a major setback no matter the circumstances.
Even so, I believe that if handled properly, it can be turned into an opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Overcoming an injury to achieve a dramatic victory—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think this is the ultimate drama
to accompany the strongest Umamusume!?"
choice_data_list: I can't let you take such a reckless risk.
...Only as long as it's within reason, though.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
you understand, don't you?
If I want to be the 'strongest,' I have no time to rest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I fully expected having to push myself a bit.
This is all part of self-producing, after all!"
choice_data_list: Does that truly lead to becoming the "strongest"?
Does that really lead to becoming the "strongest"?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...! That's... true...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A reckless gamble might sometimes be necessary
to become 'the strongest.'
However... that time is certainly not now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking a break from training for a while.
Instead, why don't we pause and carefully plan out our next move?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trainer for you.
Well then, let's head out to the track right away!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. I only gave it a light run, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Ow-ow-ow-ow!
No way, no way, this is totally impossible!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Dramatic stories really don't come about
that easily after all, do they...

Royce and Royce's injury worsened,
forcing her to take some time off to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, there's no pain.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With this method, I should be able to train
without putting strain on the injured area!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! Royce-chan's running,
overcoming all adversity, will move you to tears!

Royce and Royce continued with moderate training
and made a smooth, steady comeback.
